# Muhammad Brahmana Priambudi (Fastering18) - Portfolio

Professional portfolio of Muhammad Brahmana Priambudi, a Senior Full Stack Developer and Game Developer specializing in high-performance web applications, game mechanics, and immersive digital experiences.

## Core Expertise
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vanilla CSS.
- **Backend/Systems**: Node.js, PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM), NextAuth.js, Bun.
- **Game Dev**: Roblox Studio (Luau)
- **Design**: UI/UX, Glassmorphism aesthetics, visual storytelling.

## Key Projects
The site showcases various projects ranging from game development (Mojo City, Mojo Adventure) to technical web solutions (Fishjoy, UGC Trackers).
